title: Privacy Shield launch checklist: KMS+RBAC+Audit go-to-market & enablement matrix
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Produce a consolidated launch checklist and stakeholder-runbook for the Privacy Shield bundle (RBAC, audit logs, KMS integrations) to ensure coordinated GA across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. This ticket covers release notes coordination, cross-team GTM tasks, enablement materials, and pre-GA compliance signoffs. Scope excludes low-level implementation work (owned by ENG tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Consolidated launch checklist published and reviewed by Eng, Security, Legal, DX, Sales, and Support
Release notes (user-facing + admin changelog) drafted and merged to website and repo with example config snippets for VPC/on-prem
Customer enablement kit (runbook + KB articles + 2 onboarding playbooks) published in Confluence and product docs
2 pilot customers onboarded in Private environment and passed the smoke checklist (RBAC end-to-end, audit log sink verification, KMS key rotation test)
Security/Compliance signoff recorded (security_ticket: SEC-8122) and audit log retention/backfill tested
SRE playbook and incident rollback steps published; runbook tested in a tabletop exercise with Support and SRE
All required public and partner-facing communication assets scheduled (blog, release notes, customer email, partner brief)
milestones: 2026-04-02: GA gate decision / release readiness meeting
risks_and_mitigation: KMS key provisioning delays: mitigate by shipping a manual key import guide and temporary software KMS fallback (ENG contingency)
RBAC API backward-compat breaks with older SDKs: mitigate via SDK compatibility shim and a FAQ in release notes
Audit log volume spike could exceed retention quotas: recommend default retention settings and provide cost estimation tool in console
Compliance paperwork backlog: prioritize Legal/Security signoff items and escalate to Head of Security if >48h delay
communication_plan: Internal: #prod-private-launch Slack channel created; weekly triage on Mondays 10:00 PT
External: Targeted customer email to pilot cohort + one-pager for existing enterprise accounts
Sales: Enablement deck + 30-min live walk-through scheduled 2026-03-22
Partner: Marketplace listing checklist and partner-facing release notes provided to distribution partners 2026-03-24
tasks: PRD: finalize minor UX copy for admin RBAC screens (DX ticket DES-2097)
Docs: publish 'Private KMS onboarding' guide with CLI and UI steps (DOCS-143)
Security: complete formal threat model and provide mitigation matrix (SEC-8122)
Engineering: prepare migration test plan and run 3 smoke runs in staging (ENG-28110)
Support: update runbook with triage checklist and escalations (SUP-98)
Marketing: draft release blog and coordinated release calendar entry
